Linux modules of MicronSDR: libftx.so (FT8 / FT4 / WSPR) and libfdv.so (FreeDV)
================================================================================
Russian version: LINUX_MODULES_ru.txt
Journal, 2026-11-15. The same file is in both linux folders.

Where
  C:\Users\user\Desktop\MicronSDR_64\FT_src\linux\      prebuilt FTX module and its tests
  C:\Users\user\Desktop\MicronSDR_64\FreeDV_src\linux\  prebuilt FreeDV module and its test
  The sources and build scripts are in the parent folders (FT_src, FreeDV_src).

What is there
  FT_src\linux\
    libftx.so          FT8 / FT4 / WSPR decoders and encoders of WSJT-X (GPL-3).
                       API: FT_src\ftx_api.h (plain C). Exports only ftx_version, ftx_decode,
                       wspr_decode, ftx_encode, wspr_encode.
    test_ftx           decodes a WAV file (12000 S/s, mono, 16 bit) with libftx.so
    ft8sim, ft4sim     WSJT-X test signal generators (FT8 / FT4 WAV)
    wsprgen            WSPR test signal generator (2 min WAV)
  FreeDV_src\linux\
    libfdv.so          FreeDV: RADE V1, 1600, 700D, 700E. 48 kHz float audio in / out, works
                       in its own thread. API: FreeDV_src\fdv_api.h. Exports only fdv_*.
    libcodec2.so.1.2   codec2 (LGPL-2.1), needed by libfdv.so. Keep it in the same folder
                       as libfdv.so (libfdv.so looks for it next to itself, rpath $ORIGIN).
    test_fdv           off-air and loopback test

Requirements on the target machine
  Linux x86_64, glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Fedora 36+).
  Nothing else: libgfortran, libquadmath, libstdc++, libgcc, opus and rade_c are linked in.
  Check: ldd --version

How to use from a program
  1. Copy the .so files next to the program (or into a folder on LD_LIBRARY_PATH).
     FreeDV: libfdv.so and libcodec2.so.1.2 together.
  2. Include ftx_api.h / fdv_api.h; link with -L<dir> -lftx / -lfdv, or load at run time
     with dlopen("libftx.so") / dlopen("libfdv.so") and dlsym.
  3. Linux file names have no "lib...dll" import libraries; the API is the same as on Windows.
  Notes:
    - FT8 / FT4: ftx_decode with nzhsym = 0 decodes a whole period in one call (version 1.21).
      If you call it during the period yourself, call it at 41 or 47 first and then at 50 -
      a call at 50 alone (depth 2..3) decodes the old buffer. ftx_version() returns 121.
    - FreeDV: the write / read calls only move samples through FIFOs, they may be called
      from an audio callback.

Checking that it works (run in the linux folder; the .so is found next to the test)
  FTX:
    ./ft8sim "CQ N7DDC CN87" 1500 0.0 0.1 1.0 1 -15     -> 000000_000001.wav
    ./test_ftx ft8 000000_000001.wav
    ./ft4sim "CQ N7DDC CN87" 1500 0.0 0.1 1.0 1 -12     -> ./test_ftx ft4 000000_000001.wav
    ./wsprgen "N7DDC CN87 37" -26 1500                  -> wspr_test.wav
    ./test_ftx wspr wspr_test.wav 14.0956 3
  FreeDV (needs the rade_c sources for the test recording; build_linux.sh fetches them):
    ./test_fdv offair <deps>/rade_c      decodes rade_c's FDV_offair.wav -> offair_dec.wav
    ./test_fdv loop   <deps>/rade_c      TX -> RX loopback in every mode -> loop_*.wav
  If a file is not executable after copying from Windows: chmod +x test_ftx ft8sim ...

Results (2026-11-15)
  FT8: -19 dB decoded at every depth, -22 dB at depth 3 (the slowest window 0.93 s).
  FT4: -14 dB. WSPR: "N7DDC CN87 37" at -26 dB.
  FreeDV off-air RADE: sync after 0.55 s, 91 % in sync, SNR 28 dB, callsigns VK5KVA / VK3TPM.
  FreeDV loopback RADE / 1600 / 700D / 700E: speech decoded, RADE callsign N7DDC.

Rebuilding (on any Linux x86_64)
  FTX:    cd FT_src;     ./build_linux.sh
          needs gcc, g++, gfortran (Ubuntu: apt install gcc g++ gfortran)
          FFTW is not needed: c/fftwf_pocketfft.cpp replaces it with pocketfft (BSD-3).
          FTX_SYSTEM_FFTW=1 ./build_linux.sh uses the system FFTW (libfftw3-dev) instead.
  FreeDV: cd FreeDV_src; ./build_linux.sh ~/fdv_deps
          needs git, cmake, make, gcc, g++, wget; fetches the pinned codec2, rade_c, opus
          (+ 183 MB of opus model data) into the given folder.
  Both print "== OK: ... needs glibc X or newer" at the end. The outputs go into FT_src /
  FreeDV_src themselves (copy them into linux\ if they are to be updated there).
  Building on a newer system still gives glibc 2.35: c/glibc_compat.c (fmod) and
  fdv_glibc_compat.c (__isoc23_strtoul, arc4random) with -Wl,--wrap. For a system older
  than glibc 2.35 build on that system.
  The Windows build (build.sh, build_win.sh) is not changed.

Files changed / added for Linux
  FT_src:     build_linux.sh, c/fftwf_pocketfft.cpp, c/fftw/fftw3.h, c/pocketfft/,
              c/glibc_compat.c, ftx_api.f90 + ftx_api.h (1.21: nzhsym = 0), test/test_ftx.c
  FreeDV_src: build_linux.sh, fdv_glibc_compat.c, test_fdv.cpp (paths as arguments)
  Details: README.txt / README_ru.txt in both folders.

Licenses
  libftx.so: GPL-3 (WSJT-X, FT_src\COPYING, FT_src\AUTHORS); pocketfft BSD-3.
  libfdv.so: wrapper BSD-2, rade_c BSD-2, Opus BSD-3, rade_text / LDPC BSD-2;
  libcodec2.so: LGPL-2.1 (a separate library, may be replaced by the user).
